categorical_rules.DOWN: actionable; +1 only when canonical realized direction is DOWN, otherwise -1
categorical_rules.FLAT: actionable; +1 only when canonical realized direction is FLAT, otherwise -1
categorical_rules.NO_CLEAR_DIRECTION: non-actionable; action value 0 regardless of canonical realized direction; excluded from actionable-accuracy denominator but included in pair action value and coverage
categorical_rules.UP: actionable; +1 only when canonical realized direction is UP, otherwise -1

decision_rule.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_OF_PACK_E_IMPROVEM: all other outcomes; must not be interpreted as equivalence
decision_rule.PACK_E_IMPROVES_FORECASTING: holdout mean session-level difference > 0 and 95% interval lower bound > 0
decision_rule.PACK_E_UNDERPERFORMS_PACK_A: holdout mean session-level difference < 0 and 95% interval upper bound < 0

prohibited_uses: revise the primary metric after results are viewed
revise the holdout decision rule after results are viewed
select providers or sessions based on results

fingerprint_scope: canonical JSON of this artifact with artifact_fingerprint omitted

allowed_only_after: contract commit and tag are verified
development-only implementation validation passes without contract change
holdout_access.contract_revision_after_development_resu: requires a new untouched prospective population; the historical holdout must not be evaluated under the revised contract

missing_data.incomplete_ae_pair: excluded from paired performance metrics and retained in completeness reconciliation
missing_data.missing_required_direction_or_strength_i: UNEXPECTED_EVALUATION_FAILURE; do not impute or silently drop
missing_data.valid_partial_provider_session: included using all available complete provider pairs

primary_endpoint.name: PAIRED_ACTION_VALUE_DIFFERENCE
primary_endpoint.primary_effect: arithmetic mean of the 65 holdout Market Session statistics
primary_endpoint.session_statistic: arithmetic mean of all available complete provider-pair differences within the Market Session

prohibited_post_hoc_changes: change action values or category treatment
change bootstrap seed, resample count, interval, or quantile method
remove valid pairs or reweight providers
promote a supporting metric over the primary result
scientific_question: Does the shared request-driven Market-State Pack improve Market Session forecast performance compared with no Market-State Pack?

scientific_status.limitation: The recovered historical population was generated leakage-safely, but this evaluation contract was frozen after outcomes became available and before Pack A/E performance was inspected or scored.

secondary_metrics.A_correct_E_wrong: pairs with A action value +1 and E action value -1
secondary_metrics.A_wrong_E_correct: pairs with A action value -1 and E action value +1
secondary_metrics.NO_CLEAR_DIRECTION_rate: NO_CLEAR_DIRECTION forecasts divided by all forecasts
secondary_metrics.actionable_directional_accuracy: correct actionable forecasts divided by UP/DOWN/FLAT forecasts; report coverage beside accuracy
secondary_metrics.actionable_forecast_coverage: UP/DOWN/FLAT forecasts divided by all forecasts
secondary_metrics.complete_three_provider_robustness: repeat primary statistic and bootstrap on holdout sessions with all three complete pairs; cannot override primary
secondary_metrics.forecast_completeness: descriptive attachment/readiness counts only; not a performance endpoint
secondary_metrics.neutral_or_nonunanimous_session_reconcil: sessions containing zero differences that satisfy none of the three effect categories; reconciliation only
secondary_metrics.provider_specific_action_value_differenc: mean pair difference for each provider with same session-cluster bootstrap; supporting only
secondary_metrics.sessions_unanimously_favoring_A: every available provider pair difference in the session is strictly below zero
secondary_metrics.sessions_unanimously_favoring_E: every available provider pair difference in the session is strictly above zero
secondary_metrics.sessions_with_mixed_provider_effects: at least one provider pair difference above zero and at least one below zero
secondary_metrics.strength_accuracy: exact normalized strength accuracy by arm and paired difference; supporting only

statistical_unit.provider_pairs_within_session: clustered and averaged before primary inference
statistical_unit.provider_weighting: no post-hoc weighting; each available provider pair contributes equally within its session

strength_normalization.strength_accuracy: exact equality after normalization; supporting metric only

uncertainty.quantile_algorithm: Type 7 linear interpolation: h=(B-1)*p, interpolate sorted bootstrap estimates at floor(h) and ceil(h)
uncertainty.resampling_algorithm: Python random.Random(seed).randrange(N), repeated N times per resample; selected sessions retain all available complete provider pairs; repeated sessions contribute repeatedly
uncertainty.statistic: mean of sampled Market Session mean pair differences
